title: Jira DB
description: Each table may be a JSON array of row objects (the documented CSV-derived shape) or a TinyDB-style object keyed by row index (the shape actually produced by real jira_db.json exports, e.g. DEV/DATA/jira_db.json). run_analysis.py::normalize_table already accepts both; this schema previously only allowed the array shape and would have rejected every real export it was run against — see docs/data-model.md Sec.2.3.
